references.phrase: Grothendieck construction of a category-valued functor
references.context: Category of pairs (U,x in F(U)) and compatible morphisms, equipped with canonical projection to C.
Categorical isomorphism E≈∫F commuting with the specified functors to C, rather than equivalence ignoring projection.

references.phrase: split fibred category distinct from split fibred groupoid
references.disposition: The strict target is general Cat, not necessarily Groupoids; this formulation does not impose invertibility of every fibre arrow.

review_rationale: Reviewed split Grothendieck fibrations via a strict contravariant category-valued functor and the isomorphism of resulting fibred categories over the same base; distinguished groupoid special case.
